<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/audits/policies/{AssetAuditPolicyId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Retrieves complete details for a specific asset audit policy by ID. Returns the full policy configuration including type, name, description, affected asset groups, verification schedules, alert settings, assigned users/teams, and compliance tracking information. This endpoint provides all information needed to understand and manage a specific audit policy's configuration and status.

**Prerequisites:**
- Asset Audit Policy ID must be obtained from [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policies)

**Workflow Example:**
1. List all policies: [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policies)
2. Extract the desired policy's `AssetAuditPolicyId` from `Items[].AssetAuditPolicyId`
3. Get policy details using this endpoint

**Response Fields:**
The response includes complete policy configuration with all settings, schedules, and associations.
